title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
description: Classic soft-centered cookies with crisp edges.

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Line two baking sheets with parchment.
Beat {butter}, {brown-sugar} and {sugar} until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes.
steps.title: Cream the butter and sugars

steps.text: Beat in {eggs} one at a time, then {vanilla}.
steps.title: Beat in the eggs

steps.text: Stir in the flour mixture until just combined, then fold in {chips}.
steps.title: Fold in the chocolate
Bake
steps.text: Scoop rounded tablespoons onto the sheets, 2 inches apart. Bake 9-11 minutes until the edges are golden.
Cool on the sheet for 5 minutes, then move to a rack.
steps.title: Cool on a rack

notes: Make ahead: Chill the dough for 30 minutes for thicker cookies. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes, freeze baked cookies in an airtight container for up to 2 months. Refrigerated cookies can come to room temperature before serving. From frozen, thaw covered at room temperature, or warm in the oven at 300°F for 4–6 minutes. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/24 of recipe): 236 kcal, 3.1 g protein, 30.4 g total carbohydrate, 12.1 g fat, 1.4 g fiber, 158 mg sodium. Based on the measured ingredients; brands and optional additions can change these values.

steps.title: Set the APO
steps.text: Install the bottom drip pan. Preheat to 375°F on convection, Sous Vide OFF, rear element only, 0% steam, probe off. Use the same size pan as the preferred recipe. Start checking 3–5 minutes before the listed oven time.
